items.question: How do I place an order with Tiziwiz Delivery?
items.answer: It's simple: contact us on WhatsApp or by phone at +212 667 25 33 76, letting us know what you'd like delivered (meals, groceries, medicine, parcels...) and your address in Agadir. A courier is assigned to your order within minutes.

items.question: Can I order at any time?
items.answer: Yes, Tiziwiz Delivery is available 24/7, including weekends and public holidays, to meet both your urgent and everyday needs.

items.question: Can I change or cancel my order after placing it?
items.answer: As long as the courier hasn't yet picked up your order, you can change or cancel it by contacting us directly on WhatsApp or by phone.

items.question: How can I find out the status of my delivery?
items.answer: Our team keeps you updated by WhatsApp or phone at every stage: order pickup, en route, and delivery to your door.

items.question: What is the average delivery time in Agadir?
items.answer: It depends on the type of service and the distance, but our express deliveries are typically completed in under 30 minutes in downtown Agadir.

items.question: Do you deliver medication urgently, at night?
items.answer: Yes, our medication delivery service is available 24/7, including at night, for urgent pharmacy needs.

items.question: Can I request delivery of several items in a single run?
items.answer: Absolutely. You can combine several errands (for example, groceries and a pharmacy stop) into a single run, depending on the feasibility of the route.

items.question: What happens if I'm not available when the delivery arrives?
items.answer: Our courier will contact you before arriving. If you're unavailable, you can designate someone else to receive the order at your address.

items.question: Are Tiziwiz couriers experienced and reliable?
items.answer: Yes, our couriers are carefully selected and know the city of Agadir inside and out, ensuring fast, safe and professional deliveries.

items.question: What payment methods are accepted?
items.answer: Payment is generally made in cash on delivery. Contact us to find out the options available for your type of order.

items.question: Does the delivery price depend on distance?
items.answer: Yes, the delivery fee varies depending on the distance to travel and the type of service requested. We let you know the amount before picking up your order.

items.question: Are there extra fees for express or nighttime delivery?
items.answer: Some urgent or late-night deliveries may include a surcharge, which we always let you know before confirming the order.

items.question: Which areas of Agadir does Tiziwiz Delivery cover?
items.answer: We deliver throughout the city of Agadir and its immediate surroundings. Contact us to confirm coverage for your specific neighborhood.

items.question: Do you deliver outside Agadir?
items.answer: Our service is mainly focused on Agadir and its outskirts. For any request outside this area, contact us to discuss feasibility.

items.question: Do you offer solutions for restaurants and shops?
items.answer: Yes, we support restaurants, shops and businesses in Agadir with one-off or recurring delivery solutions tailored to their volume of activity.

items.question: Can we set up a recurring partnership with Tiziwiz Delivery?
items.answer: Absolutely. We offer terms tailored to businesses with regular delivery needs. Contact us to discuss a custom solution.

items.question: How can I contact Tiziwiz Delivery about a business request?
items.answer: You can reach us at +212 667 25 33 76 by phone or WhatsApp, or via the form on the Contact page, specifying that it's a business request.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: Tiziwiz Delivery's privacy policy: what data is collected and how it is used.

sections.heading: Data collected
sections.body: When you use this website or our services, we may collect information you voluntarily provide to us: name, phone number, delivery address and order details, notably via our contact form or our WhatsApp exchanges.

sections.heading: Use of data
sections.body: This information is used exclusively to process your delivery requests, contact you about an ongoing order, and improve the quality of our service. It is never sold to third parties.

sections.heading: Contact form and WhatsApp
sections.body: This website's contact form prepares a message that is sent via WhatsApp. The resulting exchanges are subject to WhatsApp's privacy policy, in addition to this one.

sections.heading: Data retention
sections.body: Your data is kept only for as long as necessary to process your order and manage the customer relationship, in accordance with applicable Moroccan legislation on the protection of personal data.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You may at any time request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data by contacting us at {email} or via our Contact page.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: This website may use technical cookies necessary for it to function properly. No third-party advertising cookies are used at this time.
